title: Regional Director of Quality Engineering
text:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Job Purpose:As Quality Director the role will be responsible for developing a world class quality culture and drive region wide continuous improvement projects that result in unparalleled quality performance. You will have the opportunity to reinforce foundational quality principles, as we develop innovative manufacturing, test, inspection and automation processes to build high quality semiconductor, defense and data infrastructure products. This position will be responsible for managing, coordinating and administering all functions of the region’s Quality Management System.What You'll DoLead and mentor QA organizations.Be an outspoken advocate for Quality First throughout the regionExpediently and effectively communicate with customers on quality escapes, visits, escalations, etc.Help maintain and improve the site QMS (including NCR and CAPA system, internal audit, training, etc.)Responsible for ensuring effective quality planning (including PFMEAs, process flows and control plans) for NPI and production parts.Help maintain the site QMS compliance with ISO 9001:2015 and TL9000, ISO 13485, FDA registration and any other regulatory compliance in line with the factory center of excellence Act as advisory to developing additional sources of data and tracking and reporting key Quality-related performance indicators (KPIs), including first pass yield, scrap rates and statistical process control.Oversight of managing and improving site supplier qualityBe an advocate for lean and six sigma manufacturing principles and drive continuous improvementDrive cross functional projects with manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering to verify and validate existing manufacturing processes and capabilitiesCoordinate development of Quality Plan and participate in Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews for new customer on-boardingAddress process yields by driving cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective actions utilizing a methodical approach (DMAIC) to root cause and continuous improvement. What You'll BringBachelor’s Degree required, Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial or Mfg Engineering preferred10+ years of Quality Engineering or Management experience in a regulated manufacturing environment. Printed circuit board experience is a plus but not required5+ years of direct people managementKnowledge of IPC-6012 and IPC-A-600 desiredDemonstrated experience working directly with customers to resolve concerns, conduct audits and host visitsUnderstanding of ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, TL-9000, ISO-14385, ISO-14001, MIL-PRF-31032 or similar standards with demonstrated success in passing certification auditsExpert level knowledge of root cause analysis techniques and corrective actionHands on experience working with suppliers to improve qualityKnowledge of lean principles (Green or Black belt certification a plus)Knowledge and experience in the application of statistical process controlDemonstrated experience leading diverse teams in a dynamic environment requiredExcellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills requiredOpen-minded self-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise and problem solve, as well manage multiple tasks and projects and concisely explain complex issues supported with data.Excellent analytical abilities and comprehensive understanding of quality toolbox (SPC, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, etc.) Salary Range (annual): $140,000 - $165,000 Why Join Us?At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $xx and $xx, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.Sanmina employees also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Sanmina, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation.Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. All offers of employment are contingent on the applicant either 1) being a "U.S. Person," defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident, or (iii) other protected individual, such as a refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158; or 2) being eligible to obtain a timely export control license or license exception from the applicable U.S. federal agency.
